title: Circular sorting in the alternating group
summary: The symmetric group $S_n$ is generated by transpositions, and problems of sorting permutations using transpositions are well studied. In recent work, Adin, Alon, and Roichman studied the related problem of sorting $n$ points on a circle, and gave a formula for the maximum number of adjacent swaps required. This is equivalent to the number of adjacent transpositions required to transform any permutation into a power of the cyclic permutation $(1,2,\ldots, n)$.
